subject: Replace strcmp with byte-by-byte comparison in valkey-check-aof (#2809)
reason:
The change rewrites `strncmp(buf, "
", 2) != 0` in consumeNewline of valkey-check-aof.c as `buf[0] != '' || buf[1] != '
'`. The two predicates are equivalent for all byte values: strncmp against the non-NUL literal "
" with n=2 returns non-zero exactly when byte 0 differs from '' or byte 1 differs from '
' (char signedness cannot affect an equality test, and both forms read the same two bytes). Error output, line counting, return values, and all callers are unchanged, so valkey-check-aof accepts and rejects exactly the same AOF files with the same output and exit status on both bui
